The conversation begins with discussing a public feud between Greg and Mike Israetel, where Mike allegedly insulted Greg, calling him a sociopath and other derogatory names. The conversation wraps up with Greg discussing the differences between natural and enhanced physiques, professional athletes' genetics, and the importance of mental toughness and perseverance. If you would like to send a card to Christine: https://poplarpaper.ca/

Some hard news to share about my “Sister Christine” who was just recently married to her amazing wife Terri have an adopted daughter named Sydney. I recorded videos with Christine last month but what we never shared was that Christine has MS and had been extremely week for many months but was told it’s from MS when in fact it was from extremely low hemoglobin levels as a result of a cancerous growth which forced Christine to “suffer in silence”. I never even knew how bad it was or how weak she was as Christine is such a strong person that she just chose to fight threw it. She never complained and put on a strong face to the public.
As if MS was not enough for one person to deal with, on March 2nd she was diagnosed with colon cancer. On Sunday March 7 she became very ill and went to the ER and had to have an emergency surgery for a bowel blockage related to her cancer which resulted in her having a colostomy bag. They removed the tumor but found cancer on a nearby vessel that was inoperable. She is waiting to find out when she will begin chemo but in the meantime is happy to be alive!
Covid restrictions make this very difficult as we all cannot go to visit and help keep her company.
Christine has to spend a lot of time alone in the hospital so if you have and positive energy to share in the comments please do so as she will read it all and I know it will help keep her spirits higher than last time.

Christine and her wife Terri also have card company on IG called poplar.paper.co and Terri will continue to be making cards as usual if you would like to purchase cards from them to give to your loved ones visit https://poplarpaper.ca/

I’m sure they would appreciate your support and or well wishes in these difficult circumstances. ⭕️⭕️⭕️
